title: United States household-circulation history
rule: Source observations are retained at their published cadence. The dashboard does not interpolate missing periods.

series.label: Pay reaching households
series.unit: real disposable personal income per capita (chained dollars)

series.label: Cost of staying alive
series.unit: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (index)

series.label: Breathing room / debt pressure
series.unit: household debt service payments as a percent of disposable personal income
series.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED

series.label: Customer cash / spending capacity
series.unit: real personal consumption expenditures per capita (chained dollars)
